annotations.text:
A · EVIDENCE-FIRST  — my pick

The Trust Score scan becomes the hero image instead of sitting halfway down the page. Dark fold, IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono, the Catppuccin terminal you already built promoted to the thing people see first.

Why: the live scan is the one thing on this page no other $97 SEO offer has. Leading with a real 403 and a 36/100 does the arguing for you.
Tradeoff: reads technical. A non-technical owner may see a terminal and assume this is a tool, not a service.

Direction A at phone width — the whole page, not one screen.

Headline drops to 34px, CTAs go full-width at 54px tall, the scan table loses the long leak sentence. The first screen still ends on a button.

B · EDITORIAL LEDGER

Newsreader serif over Public Sans, hairline rules, small-caps labels, blue used only as ink. The scan is a ruled ledger table, not a terminal.

Why: it matches how you already write — "capacity-true scarcity, not a countdown timer", "honest attribution". This looks like an analyst's letter, and nothing else in the category looks like it.
Tradeoff: quiet. Less obviously software, and the CTA has to work harder without a loud fold.

C · SPRINT BOARD

Space Grotesk, borders instead of shadows, compact hero. The 90-day board is the fold: all three months with full checklists visible without scrolling.

Why: answers "what do I actually get for $97" in about four seconds, which is the objection your pricing section currently absorbs.
Tradeoff: dense. It sells the mechanics well and the outcome poorly, and there is no room left for the AI-visibility story up top.

D · PRICE-FORWARD

Archivo at 88px, $97 set at 152px, one sentence, one button, a lot of white. Everything else pushed below the fold.

Why: $97 against a $2,000 category is the strongest number on the page. This is the version that makes the price the argument.
Tradeoff: the AI-visibility differentiator and the scanner both disappear below the fold, so it competes on cheapness rather than on what makes you different.

Shared across all four:

Your existing tokens — #2563eb action, #0f172a dark, slate text, the Catppuccin terminal palette, 16/10/6px radii — all carried over. Copy is lifted from the live page; nothing invented.

Emoji icons in the problem cards are replaced with stroke SVG throughout.

Direction A carries one accent-colour lever above the artboard; the other three are fixed.
